newsitem.title: UK: Sterling rallies to 4-1/2-year highs vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Sterling rallies to 4-1/2-year highs vs mark.

text.p: The British pound rose to its highest level against the German mark since September 1992, buoyed by a rising dollar and generalised mark weakness, dealers said.
Sterling rose to 2.7760 marks, its highest level since the UK left the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM) in 1992 and up more than two pfennigs from 2.7533/43 marks late Friday.
Sterling's old floor within the ERM was 2.7780 and traders said this is now a psychological target.
The pound was weaker, however, against a robust dollar, trading at $1.6245/55 compared with $1.6370/80 late last week.
